name: Letnie Vospominanija
source:
The protagonist Anton, along with his friends Anna and Veronica, immerse themselves in the best days of their summer.

A romantic story with 3 endings that are influenced by every choice you make, so it's necessary to act carefully and with clarity. 

Immerse yourself in the summertime atmosphere!

[translated from [url=https://mirrox79.itch.io/summermemories]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主人公安东与朋友安娜、维罗妮卡，一起沉浸于夏日最美好的时光。

这是一个拥有三个结局的浪漫故事。每个选择都会影响结果，因此，需要谨慎而清醒地行动。

尽情感受夏天的氛围吧！

[译自[url=https://mirrox79.itch.io/summermemories]itch.io[/url]]
